name: Droost Devel
description: Devel-powered MCP tool for Droost: generate test content, users, terms, vocabularies, menus and media via devel_generate. Submodule of Droost.
project_description: Droost Devel is a small optional submodule that exposes Drupal's Devel Generate as a single gated MCP tool, droost_generate, so an AI agent can create test data without shelling out to Drush. The tool generates content nodes, users, taxonomy terms, vocabularies, menus or media through devel_generate; arguments cover how many (num), whether to delete existing items first (kill), and which bundles to target (node types, a vocabulary, or media types). Like every state-changing Droost tool it is disabled by default and only runs when the operator has opted in via droost.settings (allow_entity_write, or the master allow_destructive) and only over the CLI/STDIO transport. It depends on the Droost base module and devel_generate. This documents the 1.0.0-rc1 pre-release.
